sources.source_kind: database or survey citing another work
sources.note: The entry's Notes (a transcription key to Hoàng 1992's orthography) state five tones for Phó Là Pu Péo with values 1 = 55 (slight final drop), 2 = 35, 3 = 44, 4 = 323, 5 = 21, and every one of the 234 forms carries a tone digit 1-5 (e.g. qami4 'hand', mhwat5 'right', bong1 'skin'). Secondhand after Hoàng Văn Ma (& Vũ Bá Hùng) 1992. For comparison, companion entry 593 (Pufeng, China, after Liang, Zhang & Li 2007) shows Chao values 33, 53, 45, 213, 24 plus 0 on minor syllables in its 226 forms but has no tone note; zh.wikipedia's six values 51/33/22/213/45/21 come from Chen Qiguang 1984.
